    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "model_df = df.dropna(subset=[\"Churn\"]).copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "X = model_df.drop(columns=[\"Churn\", \"customerID\"])\n",
        "y = model_df[\"Churn\"].map({\"No\": 0, \"Yes\": 1})\n",
        "\n",
        "numeric_features = X.select_dtypes(\n",
        "    include=[\"int64\", \"float64\"]\n",
        ").columns.tolist()\n",
        "\n",
        "categorical_features = X.select_dtypes(\n",
        "    include=[\"object\", \"category\", \"bool\"]\n",
        ").columns.tolist()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Number of input features:\", X.shape[1])\n",
        "print(\"Numeric features:\", numeric_features)\n",
        "print(\"Categorical features:\", categorical_features)\n",
        "print(\"\\nTarget distribution:\")\n",
        "print(y.value_counts())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "uUqTJF1oTA_D",
        "outputId": "0b00d210-6e02-47fc-9c25-e03c643b0f00",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        }
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Number of input features: 19\n",
            "Numeric features: ['SeniorCitizen', 'tenure', 'MonthlyCharges', 'TotalCharges']\n",
            "Categorical features: ['gender', 'Partner', 'Dependents', 'PhoneService', 'MultipleLines', 'InternetService', 'OnlineSecurity', 'OnlineBackup', 'DeviceProtection', 'TechSupport', 'StreamingTV', 'StreamingMovies', 'Contract', 'PaperlessBilling', 'PaymentMethod']\n",
            "\n",
            "Target distribution:\n",
            "Churn\n",
            "0    5174\n",
            "1    1869\n",
            "Name: count, dtype: int64\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y,\n",
        "    test_size=0.20,\n",
        "    random_state=42,\n",
        "    stratify=y\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training rows:\", X_train.shape[0])\n",
        "print(\"Testing rows:\", X_test.shape[0])\n",
        "print(\"Training churn rate:\", round(y_train.mean() * 100, 2), \"%\")\n",
        "print(\"Testing churn rate:\", round(y_test.mean() * 100, 2), \"%\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "LOYEieMDTbf0",
        "outputId": "fae0452d-0d86-4038-e007-ab7b89d33e3f"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training rows: 5634\n",
            "Testing rows: 1409\n",
            "Training churn rate: 26.54 %\n",
            "Testing churn rate: 26.54 %\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "numeric_pipeline = Pipeline([\n",
        "    (\"imputer\", SimpleImputer(strategy=\"median\")),\n",
        "    (\"scaler\", StandardScaler())\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "categorical_pipeline = Pipeline([\n",
        "    (\"imputer\", SimpleImputer(strategy=\"most_frequent\")),\n",
        "    (\"encoder\", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=\"ignore\"))\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([\n",
        "    (\"numeric\", numeric_pipeline, numeric_features),\n",
        "    (\"categorical\", categorical_pipeline, categorical_features)\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Preprocessing pipeline ready!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "MgcJP2l7TpGm",
        "outputId": "5d7f7dc7-debd-4fa3-fb18-2d17ea71eea7"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Preprocessing pipeline ready!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "logistic_model = Pipeline([\n",
        "    (\"preprocessor\", preprocessor),\n",
        "    (\"model\", LogisticRegression(\n",
        "        max_iter=2000,\n",
        "        class_weight=\"balanced\",\n",
        "        random_state=42\n",
        "    ))\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "logistic_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Logistic Regression model trained successfully!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "4tHSvICNTs81",
        "outputId": "b660e109-7674-450a-d731-b326205963ae"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Logistic Regression model trained successfully!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "random_forest_model = Pipeline([\n",
        "    (\"preprocessor\", preprocessor),\n",
        "    (\"model\", RandomForestClassifier(\n",
        "        n_estimators=200,\n",
        "        max_depth=12,\n",
        "        min_samples_leaf=3,\n",
        "        class_weight=\"balanced\",\n",
        "        random_state=42,\n",
        "        n_jobs=-1\n",
        "    ))\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "random_forest_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Random Forest model trained successfully!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "WnSpMDSpT34H",
        "outputId": "38a3c88c-f7c9-4164-cbb6-64f872962b73"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Random Forest model trained successfully!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "models = {\n",
        "    \"Logistic Regression\": logistic_model,\n",
        "    \"Random Forest\": random_forest_model\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "results = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for name, model in models.items():\n",
        "    predictions = model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "    probabilities = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "    results.append({\n",
        "        \"Model\": name,\n",
        "        \"Accuracy\": accuracy_score(y_test, predictions),\n",
        "        \"Precision\": precision_score(y_test, predictions, zero_division=0),\n",
        "        \"Recall\": recall_score(y_test, predictions, zero_division=0),\n",
        "        \"F1 Score\": f1_score(y_test, predictions, zero_division=0),\n",
        "        \"ROC AUC\": roc_auc_score(y_test, probabilities)\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "results_df = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values(\n",
        "    by=\"ROC AUC\", ascending=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "display(results_df.round(3))"
      ],
      "metadata": {

        ")\n",
